items.title: Uber faces growing AV competition but BofA sees limited market share erosion
items.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has maintained its 'buy' rating and $101 price target on Uber Technologies Inc (NYSE:UBER, XETRA:UT8), saying autonomous vehicle (AV) competition will remain the main theme for the ridesharing sector. The broker expects Uber to retain about 73% of the US mobility market...

items.title: Bank of America cuts UPS price target to $108 on lower package volumes
items.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has reiterated its 'Neutral' rating on United Parcel Service Inc (NYSE:UPS) and cut its price target to $108 from $115, citing weaker domestic package volumes and lower earnings expectations. The broker lowered its 2026 revenue estimate to $91.3 billion from $92.5...

items.title: Bank of America hikes S&P 500 target after Al trade cracks
items.summary: The bank raised its 2026 year-end target to 7,400 and set a 12-month goal of 7,800, closing out a losing bet against Alphabet and Meta in the process.

items.title: Investors Expect AI Growth to Continue, BofA Survey Shows
items.summary: Nearly 35% of investors who responded to Bank of America's September credit investor survey expect little meaningful regulation in the artificial intelligence industry in the near term. Another 22% of respondents said regulation could have an insignificant impact on AI capital expenditure.

items.title: Will JPMorgan's Selective M&A Strategy Expand Growth Runway?
items.summary: JPM's selective M&A approach is likely to add payments, data and technology capabilities while keeping organic growth at the center of its expansion strategy.
